fact: The Ministry of Health introduced the Ghana Health Information Management System (GHIMS) to manage health information across the country, replacing the failing LHIMS, per the Health Minister on 29 October 2025.

The Vice President said LHIMS was deployed in about 481 health facilities (teaching, regional, district, polyclinic and psychiatric hospitals) across all 16 regions, with over 1,000 health centres deployment ongoing.
